## Architectures

<a id="deep-voice"></a>

### Deep Voice

Neural TTS pipeline with autoregressive WaveNet synthesis.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.07825)

![Deep Voice — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/deep-voice.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.07825)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Combines grapheme-to-phoneme, duration and pitch models with a waveform generator. Segmentation is used during training.

</details>

<a id="deep-voice-2"></a>

### Deep Voice 2

Speaker-conditioned neural pipeline and WaveNet synthesis.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.08947)

![Deep Voice 2 — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/deep-voice-2.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.08947)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Extends Deep Voice with speaker embeddings and improved components. The paper also evaluates a separate multi-speaker Tacotron system.

</details>

<a id="deep-voice-3"></a>

### Deep Voice 3

Convolutional attention encoder-decoder and converter.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.07654)

![Deep Voice 3 — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/deep-voice-3.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.07654)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Autoregressively predicts acoustic features; a converter prepares the representation required by the selected waveform synthesizer.

</details>

<a id="meitei-mayek-tts"></a>

### Meitei Mayek TTS

Tacotron 2 with a Meitei Mayek phoneme frontend and HiFi-GAN.

This Manipuri speech synthesizer maps Meitei Mayek writing to an ARPAbet-based phoneme representation before acoustic generation with Tacotron 2. A HiFi-GAN vocoder reconstructs the waveform. The paper develops a single-speaker system for a language with limited training resources and tonal pronunciation requirements.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06870) · GitHub: no author-linked repository found

![Meitei Mayek TTS — Paper figure](../assets/architectures/meitei-mayek-tts.png)

*Paper figure · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06870)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

The paper illustrates the Tacotron 2 reference architecture with a WaveNet block; its reported Meitei Mayek implementation uses HiFi-GAN for waveform reconstruction.

</details>

<a id="mellotron"></a>

### Mellotron

Tacotron 2 with global style tokens, pitch and rhythm conditioning.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.11997)

![Mellotron — Input/output diagram](../assets/architectures/mellotron.svg)

*Input/output diagram · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.11997)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

Reference audio can provide prosody. The broader model also accepts musical-score controls and supports singing synthesis.

Editorial summary of documented inputs and outputs; internal architecture is not shown.

</details>

Shared encoder–decoder with modality interfaces.

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

</details>

<a id="tacotron"></a>

### Tacotron

Attention-based recurrent spectrogram synthesis.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.10135)

![Tacotron — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/tacotron.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.10135)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Maps characters to mel and linear spectrograms, then reconstructs a waveform with Griffin-Lim.

</details>

<a id="tacotron-2"></a>

### Tacotron 2

Recurrent attention model and WaveNet vocoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.05884)

![Tacotron 2 — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/tacotron-2.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.05884)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Predicts mel spectrograms from characters before waveform synthesis with a separately trained neural vocoder.

</details>

<a id="transformer-tts"></a>

### Transformer TTS

Autoregressive Transformer and WaveNet vocoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.08895)

![Transformer TTS — Figure 3](../assets/architectures/transformer-tts.png)

*Figure 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.08895)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Replaces recurrent layers with multi-head attention in the text-to-mel model. Parallel training does not make its speech decoding non-autoregressive.

</details>

<a id="wave-tacotron"></a>

### Wave-Tacotron

Autoregressive waveform blocks with a normalizing-flow decoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.03568)

![Wave-Tacotron — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/wave-tacotron.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.03568)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Models long-range dependencies across waveform blocks autoregressively and samples each block with a conditional flow.

</details>
